events.title: Visit Hela at Endix Today!
events.summary: The Endix Showcase is now live, and our little corner of the forest is officially open to visitors.If you’re exploring Endix this weekend, make sure to stop by the Hela: of Mice & Magic booth on Floor 2. You’ll be able to watch our brand-new Deep Dive video, wear a Hela-themed in-game t-shirt, and take part in a small scavenger hunt with a special surprise waiting at the end.Endix is free to explore throughout the weekend, and we’d love for you to come spend a little time with us there!

events.title: 🌲 Step Into the Forest – Our 3-Hour Ambient Video is Live
events.summary: We’ve released a new 3-hour ambient video, inspired by the peaceful pine forests of Northern Sweden, the same landscapes you will discover in the world of Hela. It’s simply a quiet place to be for a while. Wind in the trees, distant birdsong, and the feeling of a slow forest afternoon.
